payload.descriptionPlain:
At Wave, we help small businesses to thrive so the heart of our communities beats stronger.  We work in an environment buzzing with creative energy and inspiration. No matter where you are or how you get the job done, you have what you need to be successful and connected. The mark of true success at Wave is the ability to be bold, learn quickly and share your knowledge generously.


Do you love interacting directly with customers and providing amazing experiences? Have a passion for helping small business owners and entrepreneurs deal with issues with their customers? Have a knack for explaining the complex in a simple, easy to understand way?  Comfortable in a fast paced, technology driven environment? Got a competitive streak in you and love to win?  Well then, have we got a role for you!

As a member of our mighty Financial Services Operations team, you will have the unique opportunity to showcase your amazing investigative, communication and customer service skills as part of the elite chargebacks team to help win chargeback disputes on behalf of our Entrepreneurs. Reporting to the Manager, Dispute Resolution we are looking for a Disputes & Chargeback Specialist to help fight for our business owners and Wave throughout the chargeback dispute resolution cycle. This position isn't for the faint of heart; you must be ready to take on both the excitement and responsibility of being a Disputes & Chargeback Specialist and be able to guide small business owners through the entire dispute cycle to resolution. 

Looking to join this team? You'll work alongside some top notch Wavers such as Krista Cappadocia:

I’ve been with Wave now for 7 years. I originally started in customer support, worked my way to the chargebacks team, started the loss mitigations team here at Wave and now managing the Dispute Resolutions team. It has been an amazing opportunity for growth and leadership. Each day offers new challenges and opportunities to grow. In my spare time, I like hanging out with my son, dancing and watching movies!

As a Chargeback Dispute Specialist, you will offer a unique opportunity to dive deep into the
world of payments. You drive chargeback resolution by meticulously examining transactions,
collecting evidence, and communicating with merchants. Ensure adherence to card network
rules, safeguard financial integrity, and contribute to a seamless payment experience.

lists.text: Here’s How You Make an Impact:
lists.content:
• Owning chargebacks and representing cases end-to-end from informing the merchant,
    to gathering evidence, and disputing the chargeback through to resolution.
  • Acting as the go-to person, coaching and educating small business owners on the
    dispute lifecycle. Identify proactive opportunities for the business to protect themselves
    against future disputes.
  • Identifying opportunities for policy, procedure, and process improvements within
    Chargeback Operations.
  • Working closely with Risk, Finance, and Product teams to reduce loss to our customers
    & Wave.
  • Developing positive relationships with business owners, vendors, key banking partners
    or other financial institutions, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and a professional
    experience throughout.
  • Understanding the differences between card networks and being comfortable explaining
    them to customers.
  • Juggling multiple priorities, shifting between support activities (like communicating with
    business owners via email/phone), building chargeback cases from the ground up,
    assisting with Fraud prevention and reporting, developing informational content for
    customers to guide them through the chargeback process, addressing accounts
    receivable, all while meeting operational deadlines.
  • Analyzing and understanding insights into cases and interpreting those outcomes into
    ways to improve chargeback efficiency and reduce collections.

lists.text: You Thrive Here By Possessing the Following:
lists.content:
• 1- 2 years of related work experience.
  • Extensive knowledge and experience with e-commerce card payments and ACH
    payments, ideally both in Canada and the United States.
  • Solid experience handling chargebacks and dispute resolution, whether on the merchant
    or issuer side.
  • Good understanding of Payment Card Network chargeback rules and regulations.
  • Good understanding of NACHA and Payments Canada rules and regulations.
  • Understanding of full credit card chargeback dispute life cycles.
  • Excellent customer service, relations and/or vendor management skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills. A desire to support others with the intent of achieving
    team goals.
  • Ability to effectively manage deadlines in a fast-paced and high-volume environment.
  • Experience managing collection and/or credit risk practices.
  • Knowledge of fraud and risk best practices or experience working in a fintech company
    would be an asset.

The Group Product Manager, Core Services is a strategic and highly technical product leader responsible for defining and scaling the shared services layer that powers product innovation across the organization. This role owns the strategy and execution of core shared services, including orchestration workflows, business capabilities, and reusable platform services, that enable customer-facing product teams to build, launch, and scale experiences efficiently, consistently, and at scale.
 
This leader manages a team of Product Managers and brings deep platform product management experience with a strong internal customer mindset – driving adoption of shared services, APIs, and workflow capabilities while balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term platform health. This role requires strong business judgment, technical fluency, and influential leadership to partner across the organization and build toward a unified platform vision.

lists.text: Here’s How You Make an Impact:
lists.content:
• Define and lead the product vision, strategy, roadmap, OKRs, and success metrics for the Core Services group that enable product teams to build and scale efficiently.
  • Collaborate deeply with Engineering, Architecture, and Data leaders to shape Core Services direction, guide critical technical and business trade-offs, and prioritize investments across scalability, reliability, data foundations, and operational efficiency.
  • Own the Core Services orchestration layer across system, services, and data flows – acting as the product leader for internal customers (product teams, engineers, and data partners) by identifying reusable services, APIs, workflows, and data capabilities that reduce duplication, improve consistency, and accelerate delivery while maintaining scalability, extensibility, and resilience.
  • Drive adoption and impact of shared services across the organization, leading onboarding, enablement, documentation, and change management to ensure teams effectively leverage platform capabilities and standards.
  • Define and monitor platform health and success metrics, including adoption, usage, service reliability, performance, and return on foundational investments.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers, establishing strong platform product management practices across discovery, prioritization, execution, and cross-functional alignment.
  • Drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Data, Design, and business stakeholders – partnering closely with product and technical leaders to ensure Core Services evolves in step with the company’s product vision, translating complex technical concepts into clear business value and guiding leaders on key trade-offs between speed, scale, risk, and longterm platform health.
  • Identify and leverage AI-enabled capabilities and workflows to improve product velocity, quality, aligned with business priorities and deliver measurable impact.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, driving operational excellence through retrospectives, learning, coaching, and ongoing refinement of platform processes and ways of working.

lists.text: You Thrive Here By Possessing the Following:
lists.content:
• Experience owning platform, infrastructure, API, developer tooling, data platform, or other highly technical products used by internal teams or external developers.
  • Strong technical fluency in distributed systems, platform architecture, service-oriented design, cloud or infrastructure concepts, and data foundations, with the ability to engage credibly with architects, senior engineers, and data leaders in both strategic and tactical discussions.
  • Proven ability to define product strategy, derive requirements, analyze trade-offs, and prioritize investments across multiple teams and stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
  • Demonstrated experience translating complex technical platform investments into measurable business outcomes such as increased scale, improved reliability, reduced cost, faster delivery, or stronger customer and developer experiences.
  • Strong people leadership experience, including leading Product Managers, developing talent, setting priorities, and building high-performing teams.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences and influence senior stakeholders across business and technology functions.
  • Strong business acumen, including experience building business cases, evaluating tradeoffs, and aligning product investments to customer value, company priorities, and financial outcomes.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data-related field, or a related discipline, or the equivalent through a combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • 8+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex, highly technical products with significant business and technology impact, with a minimum of 2+ years leading product teams at the Group level or above.

The Group Product Manager, Financial Services is a strategic product leader responsible for Wave/SMB’s payments capabilities and broader financial services experiences that help small businesses move, manage, and trust their money. This role leads Product Managers across payments acceptance and processing, platform modernization, risk and fraud mitigation, and future financial services capabilities. 

The ideal candidate can balance near-term platform stability, compliance, reliability, and customer trust with the longer-term vision for how financial services power a unified, year-round SMB experience. They will translate strategy into execution by setting clear priorities, managing product budgets, improving discovery and development practices, and creating the operating rhythm needed to deliver measurable outcomes. This is a coach-player role for a leader who can operate with senior stakeholders, dig into operational and technical details when needed, and coach Product Managers through ambiguity.

lists.text: Here’s How You Make an Impact:
lists.content:
• Define and own the product vision and strategy for Financial Services for the Small Business product suite. 

  • Lead the team through active platform modernization work, including our payments infrastructure migration, reduce fraud exposure, resolve reliability gaps, and restore and build customer trust. 

  • Own uptime, reliability, and observability commitments for payments surfaces, partnering with Engineering and Data teams to meet aggressive platform stability SLAs on some of our most business-critical systems. 

  • Partner closely with Fraud/Risk Operations, Compliance, and Security on onboarding, underwriting, and fraud mitigation practices, ensuring the product meets regulatory and risk standards without sacrificing customer experience. 

  • Collaborate with other product leads — particularly Accounting and Tax — to ensure payments/ financial services workflows integrate cleanly into a seamless, end-to-end SMB experience rather than operating as a silo. 

  • Manage key stakeholders and business partners across Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Finance, Risk/Fraud Operations, Compliance, Security, and Marketing to align on priorities, execute the product vision, and deliver against clear metrics and outcomes. 

  • Craft logical business cases, understand financial impacts, and define and execute business and customer benefit OKRs. Use data to prioritize opportunities, demonstrate product value, and impact KPIs. 

  • Identify where AI can meaningfully improve day-to-day team productivity, and where AI can strengthen fraud detection, risk decisioning, operational workflows, or the customer-facing experience. 

  • Be viewed as a subject matter expert in financial services by presenting compelling strategy and plans, and providing business leadership that drives results for your team. 

  • Build and coach a high-performing product team by setting clear ownership, raising the quality of product thinking, helping Product Managers connect strategy to execution, and creating the conditions for strong cross-functional collaboration. 

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, driving operational excellence through retrospectives, coaching, and ongoing refinement of team processes and ways of working.

lists.text: You Thrive Here By Possessing the Following:
lists.content:
• 8+ years of experience in product management, with a minimum of 5 years in the fintech industry, and 2+ years leading product teams at the Group level or above. 

  • Deep expertise in financial services, ideally with a strong background in payments acquiring, acceptance, payment facilitation, fraud and risk controls, and processor or platform partnerships. 

  • In-depth knowledge of financial products onboarding experiences, including KYC and KYB, and risk and fraud mitigation practices. 

  • Experience with payment processor or platform partnerships and migrations at scale is a strong plus, especially in environments where reliability, fraud exposure, compliance obligations, customer trust, and business continuity all need to be managed at the same time. 

  • Proven track record leading product teams and taking new products from ideation to launch to scale in a fintech environment. 

  • Comfort operating under compliance, regulatory, and audit constraints without losing sight of customer and business outcomes. 

  • Demonstrated judgment on where to apply AI — able to identify high-leverage opportunities to improve your team's own productivity, as well as opportunities to strengthen fraud/risk decisioning or the customer experience. 

  • Strong stakeholder management and leadership skills, with the ability to effectively communicate and influence customers, business partners, engineers, and cross-functional partners across the organization. 

  • Proven ability to prioritize and make hard decisions in a fast-paced environment, while actively identifying and mitigating issues that could impact successful completion of goals. 

  • Strong people leadership experience, including leading Product Managers, developing talent, setting priorities, and building high-performing teams, with genuine comfort operating as a coach-player. 

  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical and financial concepts clearly to non-technical audiences and influence senior stakeholders across business and technology functions. 

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data-related field, or a related discipline, or the equivalent through a combination of education and relevant work experience.
